contractRoleMeaning: inputKinds and outputKind are logical adapter roles; matching an exported TypeScript name does not authorize serialization or supply a runtime JSON schema.
newOutputBoundary: Dedicated ModelResult contracts are model-facing. Three author-view candidate contracts require explicit recursive projections and host rebinding; their persisted records are not model tool schemas.
legacyRoleBoundary: Legacy roles and unresolved adapter roles are retained by name with no invented TypeScript alias or executable serializer.
initialWorkPolicy: The host initializes and versions AuthorContract from original input plus explicit empty/default constraints; initial_work requires no invented accepted prose/world version.
qualityStatisticsPolicy: Host computes inclusion, exclusion, denominators, strata and statistics hashes. The model receives a read-only disclosed evidence projection and returns conclusions only; the immutable HostSnapshot is never sent.
optionalAdjunctPolicy: Parsed core is independently validated; invalid or absent optional projection payloads do not block a valid core gate. Invalid transport JSON or invalid core still stops core work.
